description: A colour-coded waveform: the derived-media peaks, one colour per peaks pixel from the frames series (hue from spectral centroid or pitch-class profile, lightness from RMS level), a palette describing the mapping, and a PNG preview of the whole recording.

peaks.description: the derived-media peaks (ADR 0069, peaks-1): audiowaveform binary version 2, 8-bit, every channel, samples_per_pixel the source rate over 100

colour.description: red, green, blue for each peaks pixel, row k centred half a pixel into pixel k

palette.description: the mapping, the decibel range lightness spans, and legend stops (archive-colour-palette/1)

preview.description: the whole recording as an RGBA image, transparent behind the waveform
